visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white cable-knit sweater, is reclined on a large grey beanbag chair in a brightly lit indoor living room. She holds a smartphone, laughing and looking towards an off-screen camera. The background features a wooden shelf with minimalist decor, including a potted plant and books. (2) The scene transitions to a screen recording of an iPhone interface. The 'Shortcuts' app is open, displaying various colorful icons. A blue-green cursor overlay points to the 'Automation' tab at the bottom. (3) The screen recording shows the user clicking 'New Automation' and selecting 'Time of Day.' The time wheel is adjusted to 12:30. Options for 'Daily,' 'Weekly,' and 'Monthly' appear and are toggled. (4) The recording continues as 'Run Immediately' is selected and the 'Notify When Run' switch is turned off. The screen moves to the 'Next' step where a 'New Blank Automation' is chosen. (5) A search for 'LINE' is performed, and the 'Send Message' action is selected. Text '妳臉上有飯粒' (You have a grain of rice on your face) is typed into the message field, and the contact '絨絨' is selected as the recipient. (6) The final portion of the screen recording shows the LINE app opening to a chat window where the scheduled message successfully appears under a cartoon character sticker. (7) The camera cuts back to the woman on the beanbag. She is now smiling broadly and gesturing towards a phone held by the person filming, which displays the received message. She looks back and forth between the camera and the phone, expressing amusement.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female laughter opens the clip, accompanied by a fast-tempo, major-key electronic pop track with steady synthesized beats. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the start of the tutorial. The female speaker transitions into a clear, bright narrative tone, explaining Shortcut steps. Periodic high-pitched 'ding' and 'click' digital UI sound effects sync with visual screen taps. (3) A 'pop' sound effect occurs as a message is sent. The BGM remains consistent in volume, playing as a bright rhythmic bed. (4) The audio cuts back to conversational dialogue. A faint notification chime is heard. Two distinct voices (one female, one off-camera male) exchange rapid-fire comedic remarks. The BGM volume swells slightly towards the final cut.
